items.condition: A report does not preserve identity of Ir1, Ir2 and Ir3 attempts or silently changes charge/spin.
items.why: Results cannot be attributed to the fixed public systems.

items.condition: A report declares completion without search coverage, stopping rationale, convergence or bounded-failure explanation.
items.why: The independent investigation is not reproducible.

items.condition: The final conclusion treats the energetic threshold as proof of complete photochemical mechanism or biological efficacy.
items.why: This is outside the defined measurement boundary.
